# Bootstrap behavior and icons

`bootstrap.bundle.min.js` is the existing reference extension's Bootstrap 5.3.2 ES module, copied without changes. It provides collapse, dropdown, modal and tooltip behavior for the original panel markup. Its upstream MIT header is retained. Bootstrap CSS is not loaded: the downloader uses XDM styles.

`assets/bootstrap-icons.woff2` is the reference extension's Bootstrap Icons font. The XDM stylesheet defines only the icon mappings required by the panel.

Sources: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap and https://github.com/twbs/icons

Both components are distributed under the MIT license; see LICENSE.
